text: Hint 1: Consider how adding a new feature, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, might affect the model's ability to fit the training data. Think about the flexibility of the model and how it might capture more patterns in the data.\n\nHint 2: Remember that the MSE on training data is influenced by how well the model fits the data it was trained on. Adding a new feature can potentially reduce the training error by allowing the model to better capture the underlying relationships in the data.
